h1: High Quality Kitchen Cabinets London Ontario
title: High Quality Kitchen Cabinets London Ontario
description: White Shaker RTA kitchen cabinets in London, Ontario with free delivery, plywood boxes, solid hardwood doors, and a written quote in one business day.
intro: RTA Cabinets Canada is based right here in London, Ontario, and our White Shaker RTA kitchen cabinets are a popular choice for homeowners across the city. Every order includes free delivery, since London sits at the centre of our 300 km free delivery zone.
distanceNote: We ship directly from our London, Ontario location, so most London orders arrive on the fastest lead times we offer.

sections.heading: Why White Shaker Works in London Homes
sections.body:
London's housing stock ranges from century-old character homes in Old North and Woodfield to newer subdivisions in Hyde Park and Riverbend, and White Shaker cabinetry suits nearly all of them. The clean recessed panel and painted white finish read as traditional in an older kitchen and as fresh and current in a new build, which is why it remains one of the most requested cabinet styles for renovations and new construction alike.

Because the style is so neutral, it also makes resale easier. Buyers touring a London home rarely object to a white Shaker kitchen, and it pairs with almost any countertop, backsplash, or hardware finish a homeowner might choose later. For anyone renovating a kitchen with an eye toward eventually selling, or simply wanting a kitchen that will not look dated in ten years, White Shaker is a safe and attractive choice.

We also hear from London customers who are matching an addition or a secondary space, like a basement bar or laundry room, to their existing kitchen. Since our lineup covers 58 SKUs, from full-height pantries down to fillers and mouldings, it is usually possible to extend a kitchen's look into another room without a custom order.

sections.heading: What's Included and the Build Quality
sections.body:
Every cabinet in our White Shaker line uses a plywood box rather than particleboard, which holds screws and hardware far better over time and resists sagging under the weight of dishes, pots, and small appliances. The face frames and doors are solid hardwood with a painted white finish, and every door and drawer is soft-close standard, no upgrade required.

Our base cabinets are 34.5 inches tall and 24 inches deep, and wall cabinets are 12 inches deep and 36 inches tall as the standard height, with a 30 inch tall wall line coming soon for kitchens that need a shorter run under a bulkhead or window. Across the 58 available SKUs you will find base cabinets, drawer bases, sink bases, corner cabinets including lazy susan and blind corner options, wall cabinets, pantries, and specialty pieces like glass door cabinets, wine racks, microwave cabinets, and over-fridge cabinets, plus the fillers, panels, and mouldings needed to finish a run cleanly.

Because the boxes are plywood and the doors are solid hardwood, these cabinets are built to the same standard many custom shops use, just assembled by the homeowner or installer rather than the factory, which is what keeps the price down.

sections.heading: How Ordering Works
sections.body:
Most London customers start by building a cabinet list themselves or by designing their layout in our free 3D Kitchen Planner at /planner, which makes it easy to see how a run of cabinets will fit a specific kitchen before committing to anything. Once a list is ready, we do not process payment online. Instead, you submit the list and we prepare a written quote, which we return within one business day.

From the time an order is confirmed, lead time is typically 2 to 3 weeks. Because London is our home base, delivery is free and straightforward, and there is no freight calculation to wait on the way there would be for orders shipping farther across the country.

If you would rather not assemble the cabinets yourself, we offer an expert assembly service for $75 per cabinet, which is a popular option for London customers on a renovation timeline who want the cabinets ready to install rather than flat-packed.

sections.heading: Popular Layouts and Kitchen Packages
sections.body:
For homeowners who want a simpler starting point than building a list SKU by SKU, we offer fixed kitchen packages in 10x10, 10x12, and 12x12 configurations. These are common kitchen footprints in London's older neighbourhoods and in many of the city's mid-size subdivision homes, and the packages give a clear sense of what a full kitchen's worth of cabinetry costs before requesting a custom quote.

For London kitchens that do not match those footprints exactly, which is common in older homes with irregular walls or in larger newer builds, our team can work from a custom list instead. The lazy susan and blind corner options are especially useful in London's many L-shaped kitchens, and the pantry cabinets are a frequent add for homes that were built without a dedicated pantry closet.

sections.heading: Financing and Our Guarantee
sections.body:
We offer 0% APR financing for customers who want to spread the cost of a full kitchen over time rather than paying it all up front, which is worth asking about when your written quote comes back. We also stand behind a Lowest Price Guarantee, and we work to keep cabinet shipping fast once an order is confirmed.

If you want to see and feel the finish before ordering a full kitchen, we offer a refundable $35 sample door, which is a low-risk way to confirm the White Shaker finish and hardware will look right in your London kitchen before you commit. Between the local delivery, the sample door, and the written quote process, London customers have several ways to de-risk the decision before ordering.

sections.heading: London Neighbourhoods We Regularly Supply
sections.body:
We see steady demand from across London's neighbourhoods, from Byron and Oakridge in the west end to Pond Mills and White Oaks in the south, as well as Masonville and Stoneybrook in the north end. Each of these areas has its own housing character, but the request is often the same: a durable, neutral kitchen that will not need replacing again in five years.

Older London neighbourhoods like Old South and Wortley Village frequently call for kitchens that respect original trim and window casings, and White Shaker's simple lines tend to work well alongside that older architecture rather than fighting it. Meanwhile, homeowners finishing basements or rental units in London's many student-heavy areas near Western University often choose a smaller, simpler cabinet list from the same line, since our SKUs scale down easily to a compact kitchenette without losing the plywood-box, solid hardwood construction that defines the whole product line.

faqs.a: We operate as a quote-based cabinet supplier rather than a walk-in showroom. The best way to see the finish and quality before ordering is to request our refundable $35 sample door, which lets you inspect the White Shaker finish and hardware in your own kitchen.

faqs.q: How fast can I get cabinets since you're based in London?
faqs.a: Lead time is typically 2 to 3 weeks from order confirmation regardless of location, but because we ship from London, delivery itself is fast once cabinets are ready, and it's always free since London falls well within our 300 km free delivery zone.

faqs.q: Can I design my kitchen layout before requesting a quote?
faqs.a: Yes. Our free 3D Kitchen Planner at /planner lets you lay out your kitchen and see how our White Shaker cabinets fit before you submit a list. Many London customers use it to test a few layout options, check corner cabinet placement, and confirm sizing before requesting their written quote.

faqs.q: What's the difference between the plywood box and cheaper RTA cabinets?
faqs.a: Many lower-cost RTA cabinets use particleboard boxes, which don't hold hardware and screws as well over time. Our cabinets use a plywood box with solid hardwood face frames and doors, which holds up better to daily use and repeated opening and closing.

faqs.q: Do you offer assembly if I don't want to build the cabinets myself?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer an expert assembly service for $75 per cabinet. It's a popular add-on for London customers working to a renovation deadline who want the cabinets to arrive fully assembled and install-ready rather than spending weekend hours building each box before the installer can start work.

faqs.q: Do you deliver free to Ingersoll and Tillsonburg too?
faqs.a: Yes, both Ingersoll and Tillsonburg are within our 300 km free delivery zone from London, so free delivery applies there the same as it does in Woodstock, with no separate freight quote needed and no added delivery charge on your written quote.

faqs.q: How fast can I get a written quote?
faqs.a: We return a written quote within one business day of receiving your cabinet list, whether built manually or through the free 3D Kitchen Planner at /planner, and no payment is required online before your quote is confirmed and your order is placed.

faqs.q: What's the typical lead time for a Woodstock order?
faqs.a: Lead time is typically 2 to 3 weeks from order confirmation, and delivery to Woodstock and the surrounding area is free. Because Woodstock sits close to our London base, delivery tends to move quickly once the cabinets are ready to ship.

faqs.q: Can you assemble the cabinets before delivery?
faqs.a: Yes, our expert assembly service is $75 per cabinet, so the kitchen arrives ready to install rather than flat-packed. It's a convenient option for Woodstock area homeowners who would rather skip the assembly step and move straight into installation with their contractor.

faqs.q: Are fixed kitchen packages available for smaller Woodstock kitchens?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer 10x10, 10x12, and 12x12 fixed kitchen packages, which suit many standard kitchen footprints in the area, or you can build a custom list instead if your layout includes an island, pantry, or corner cabinet configuration that a fixed package doesn't cover.
